t: You're looking at a Portland stone statue standing at the centre of Golden Square in Soho. It shows a man in Roman dress, who has commonly been identified as George II, although the evidence for that is sparse. George II was King of Great Britain and Ireland from 1727 until 1760. The statue is attributed to John Nost, a Flemish sculptor who worked in England in the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries. It has been Grade II listed since January 1970.
